```{r Census Pull Loop, include=TRUE}
cbsa_area <- read_delim("2025_Gaz_cbsa_national.txt", 
    delim = "|", escape_double = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE) %>%
    rename(GEOID = GEOID,
           land_area_sqkm = ALAND_SQMI) %>%
    mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID))
  

years <- c(2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

vars <- c(
  population = "B01003_001",
  med_income = "B19013_001",
  med_rent   = "B25064_001",
  med_value  = "B25077_001"
)

get_one_year <- function(year) {

  message(paste("Pulling year:", year))

  df <- get_acs(
    geography = "metropolitan statistical area/micropolitan statistical area",
    variables = vars,
    year = year,
    survey = "acs1",
    cache_table = TRUE
  ) %>%
    select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

  # Merge land area
  df <- df %>%
    left_join(cbsa_area, by = "GEOID") %>%
    mutate(
      density = population / land_area_sqkm,
      year = year
    )

  return(df)
}

agglo_data <- map_dfr(years, get_one_year)

agglo_data <- agglo_data %>%
  select(-NAME.x)

agglo_data <- agglo_data%>%
  rename(NAME = NAME.y)

agglo_data <- agglo_data %>%
  relocate(NAME)

setdiff(unique(agglo_data$GEOID), unique(cbsa_area$GEOID))

length(unique(agglo_data$GEOID))  # before
length(unique(agglo_data %>% filter(GEOID %in% cbsa_area$GEOID) %>% pull(GEOID)))

agglo_data <- agglo_data %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% cbsa_area$GEOID)

agglo_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(n_metros = n_distinct(GEOID))

balanced_cbsa <- agglo_data %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year)) %>%
  filter(n_years == length(unique(agglo_data$year))) %>%
  pull(GEOID)

agglo_balanced <- agglo_data %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% balanced_cbsa)

agglo_balanced %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(n_metros = n_distinct(GEOID))
```

```{r Create Agglomeration Index, include=TRUE}
agglo_balanced <- agglo_balanced %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    z_income  = as.numeric(scale(med_income)),
    z_rent    = as.numeric(scale(med_rent)),
    z_value   = as.numeric(scale(med_value)),
    z_density = as.numeric(scale(log(density))),

    agglo_index = (z_income + z_rent + z_value + z_density) / 4
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```

```{r Load in IPUMS Data, include=TRUE}
ipums_ddi_file <- read_ipums_ddi(here("00_rawdata", "usa_00003.xml"))

ipums_data <- read_ipums_micro(ipums_ddi_file)

#Crosswalk File
puma_cbsa_crosswalk <- read_csv(here("00_rawdata", "geocorr2022_2610402029.csv"))

crosswalk_clean <- puma_cbsa_crosswalk %>%
  group_by(puma22) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = pop20, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(puma22, GEOID = cbsa20)
```

```{r Pull in IPUMS data as Arrow Dataset, include = TRUE}
# Write to CSV (more memory efficient than parquet conversion)
fwrite(ipums_data, "ipums_temp.csv")

# Clear from memory
rm(ipums_data)
gc()

# Now convert CSV to Parquet using Arrow (streaming)
library(arrow)
ipums_dataset <- read_csv_arrow("ipums_temp.csv", as_data_frame = FALSE)
write_parquet(ipums_dataset, "ipums_compressed.parquet")

# Remove temporary CSV
file.remove("ipums_temp.csv")

# Load as Arrow dataset (lazy evaluation)
ipums_dataset <- open_dataset("ipums_compressed.parquet")

# Check it worked
ipums_dataset


```

```{r Step 1: Set-Up Data Table, include=TRUE}
# Pull only needed columns
ipums_dt <- ipums_dataset %>%
  select(YEAR, PUMA, HHWT, OWNERSHP, RENT, OWNCOST, HHINCOME, STATEFIP) %>%
  collect() %>%
  as.data.table()

```

```{r Step 2: Construct Cost Burden Measure, include=TRUE}
ipums_dt[, PUMA := str_pad(as.character(PUMA), 5, pad = "0")]

ipums_dt[, cost := fifelse(OWNERSHP %in% c(3,4), RENT, OWNCOST)]

ipums_dt <- ipums_dt[HHINCOME > 0 & cost > 0]

ipums_dt[, cost_burden := (cost * 12) / HHINCOME]
ipums_dt[, year := YEAR]

```

```{r Step 3: Prepare Crosswalk, include=TRUE}
setDT(crosswalk_clean)

crosswalk_clean[, PUMA := str_pad(as.character(puma22), 5, pad = "0")]
crosswalk_clean[, GEOID := as.character(GEOID)]

setkey(crosswalk_clean, PUMA)
setkey(ipums_dt, PUMA)

ipums_dt <- crosswalk_clean[ipums_dt]

mean(is.na(ipums_dt$GEOID))
```

```{r Step 4: Collapse Data, include=TRUE}
cbsa_panel <- ipums_dt[
  , .(cost_burden = weighted.mean(cost_burden, HHWT, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(GEOID, year)
]
```

```{r Step 5: Compute Cost Burden Over Time, include=TRUE}
cbsa_panel[, year_c := year - mean(year)]

cbsa_trends <- cbsa_panel[
  , .(
    slope = coef(lm(cost_burden ~ year_c))[2]
  ),
  by = GEOID
]
```

```{r Step 6: Merging Data, include=TRUE}
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

cbsa_shapes <- core_based_statistical_areas() %>%
  st_transform(2163)  # better projection for US maps

map_data <- cbsa_shapes %>%
  left_join(cbsa_trends, by = "GEOID")

map_data2 <- map_data %>%
  mutate(slope_q = ntile(slope, 5))
```

```{r Step 7: Plot Chloropleth Map, include=TRUE}
chloropleth1 <- ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = slope), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Trend in Housing Cost Burden by Metro (2010–2024)",
    subtitle = "Estimated annual change (slope)",
    fill = "Annual Change"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


chloropleth2 <- ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = slope), color = NA) +
  coord_sf(crs = 'ESRI:102003') +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Trend in Housing Cost Burden by Metro (2010–2024)",
    subtitle = "Estimated annual change (slope)",
    fill = "Annual Change"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(chloropleth2)

map_data_shifted <- shift_geometry(map_data)

chloropleth3 <- ggplot(map_data_shifted) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = slope), color = NA) +
  coord_sf(crs = 'ESRI:102003') +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Trend in Housing Cost Burden by Metro (2010–2024)",
    subtitle = "Estimated annual change (slope)",
    fill = "Annual Change"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(chloropleth3)
```

```{r Step 8: Map Refinement and Diagnostics, include=TRUE}


setDT(cbsa_panel)

cbsa_panel[
  , .(n_cbsa = uniqueN(GEOID)),
  by = year
][order(year)]

cbsa_coverage <- cbsa_panel[
  , .(n_years = uniqueN(year)),
  by = GEOID
]

summary(cbsa_coverage$n_years)


cbsa_panel[
  , .(
    mean_cb = mean(cost_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cb   = sd(cost_burden, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = year
][order(year)]


```

```{r Set Up Balanced Panel, include=TRUE}
full_years <- length(unique(cbsa_panel$year))

balanced_cbsa <- cbsa_panel[
  , .(n_years = uniqueN(year)),
  by = GEOID
][n_years == full_years, GEOID]

cbsa_panel_balanced <- cbsa_panel[GEOID %in% balanced_cbsa]

```
